commits.comment: 将 DCP（DeepContext Parallel）注意力 A2A pack 流程中空 shard 的 LSE 掩码从独立的 eager pass 融合进 Triton pack kernel。变更重构出 `_validate_dcp_empty_shard_args` 做参数校验（返回是否启用掩码），并在 kernel 内通过 searchsorted 风格边界查找将 -inf 写入空请求/越界 padding 行的 LSE 槽位，避免每个 MLA 层启动约 8 个 launch-bound 掩码 kernel。测试覆盖 uniform/ragged query 布局并验证融合结果与 eager 路径逐位一致（int16 位级比较）。接口签名不变，但启用掩码时的执行路径从 eager 切到 kernel 内融合。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/attention/ops/dcp.py 为 DCP 注意力共享算子文件（vllm-ascend 的 DCP/上下文并行后端复用该模块）。本次将空 shard 的 LSE 掩码从 eager pass 移入 Triton pack kernel：当调用方传入 seq_lens/query_start_loc 时，_dcp_a2a_pack_send 不再先调用 mask_dcp_empty_shards_，而是在 kernel 内以 HAS_MASK 分支完成掩码。vllm-ascend 若在 NPU 上以启用掩码的方式调用该函数，执行路径发生变化，需确认 Triton kernel 在 NPU 上的兼容性与正确性（上游测试仅覆盖 CUDA/ROCm）。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
Commit 83990f5bcc0b renames `vllm.v1.worker.gpu.cp_utils.prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` to `maybe_prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens`, adds a keyword-only `num_reqs_padded` arg, changes the return to the padded view (or None when dcp_size==1), and moves DCP metadata initialization from `GPUModelRunner.prepare_inputs()`/`PCPManager.partition_batch()` to after batch partitioning (injected in `GPUModelRunner.execute_model` right before `model_state.prepare_attn`, using `self.pcp_manager.input_buffers` when PCP is active). Adaptations required in vllm-ascend:
1. `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:32` — replace `from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.cp_utils import prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` with `maybe_prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` (the old symbol no longer exists; this import currently raises ImportError and blocks MRV2 startup).
2. `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:432-442` (inside the `prepare_inputs` override) — delete the pre-partition DCP computation and pass `dcp_local_seq_lens=None` into `AscendInputBatch`. Keep parity with the fix: DCP-local seq lens must be computed from the post-partition `input_batch.seq_lens`/`num_reqs`. Since ascend does not override `GPUModelRunner.execute_model`'s new block nor `prepare_attn`, the base runner now populates `input_batch.dcp_local_seq_lens` (from `pcp_manager.input_buffers.dcp_local_seq_lens`) after partitioning and before `AscendModelState.prepare_attn` runs — verify this value flows through `model_states/default.py:94` and `attn_utils.py:280` unchanged.
3. `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/pcp_manager.py:284-290` (`AscendPCPManager.partition_batch`) — after the base `PCPManager.partition_batch` forces `dcp_local_seq_lens=None`, the `if local_batch.dcp_local_seq_lens is not None` guard becomes always-false, so the FULL-decode-graph zeroing of `input_buffers.dcp_local_seq_lens[actual_reqs:graph_num_reqs]` is skipped. `maybe_prepare_dcp_local_seq_lens` only writes the first `num_reqs` rows, so the padded rows `[num_reqs:num_reqs_after_padding]` would retain stale values on graph replay. Reconcile this: either recompute/zero the DCP buffer after the base partition (matching the new helper's padded-view semantics) or move the padding into ascend's post-partition path so replay reads valid zeros.
4. Do NOT adapt `flashinfer.py`/`cp_utils` internals: the FlashInfer changes (dcp_query_start_loc masking, `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size` rename, num_blocks ordering) are CUDA-only and vllm-ascend already uses `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size`. The ubatch_utils change (per-microbatch `ubatch_dcp_local_seq_lens` via `_slice_input_batch`) is inherited from the base `UBatchRunner`, which ascend does not override; no changes needed unless ascend adds its own ubatch slicing.
5. Keep the unit tests in `tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch_v2.py` / `test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py` in sync with the pinned vllm version used by vllm-ascend CI.
deep_analysis.risk: medium — DCP is only active when `decode_context_parallel_size > 1` (NPU attention backends such as SFA/MLA-CP consume `dcp_local_seq_lens` for cross-rank KV reduction masking). The hard ImportError in `model_runner.py:32` breaks the entire MRV2 worker until fixed, not just DCP runs. Beyond the rename, the main functional risk is stale/mis-padded `dcp_local_seq_lens` during FULL decode-only CUDA-graph replay: if the ascend-specific zeroing in `AscendPCPManager.partition_batch` silently stops executing (base now returns None), graph padding rows between `num_reqs` and `num_reqs_after_padding` may hold old values, yielding incorrect attention masks and wrong outputs on multi-rank DCP. A regression test exercising PCP+DCP under FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs is recommended.

[MM][CG] Enable encoder CUDA Graph for MiniCPM-V (#42785)

Signed-off-by: YunzhuLu <lucia.yunzhu@gmail.com>

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit (encoder CUDA Graph for MiniCPM-V, #42785) hard-breaks the Ascend encoder ACL-graph path. vllm-ascend's EncoderAclGraphManager (vllm_ascend/worker/encoder_acl_graph.py) subclasses vllm.v1.worker.encoder_cudagraph.EncoderCudaGraphManager and overrides _capture_budget_graph / _run_budget_graph with the OLD signatures. The new base class now ALWAYS calls both with an axis_keys kwarg: capture() loops `for axis_keys in itertools.product(*self._capture_axes)` (yields `()` even when capture_axes is empty) and execute_budget() forwards axis_keys from _select_items(), which now returns a `(dict, CaptureAxisKeys)` tuple. Consequence: a hard `TypeError: ... unexpected keyword argument 'axis_keys'` on the first capture for EVERY encoder-CG model on NPU (Qwen2/2.5/3-VL, Gemma3, Idefics3, MiniCPM-V, ...), not just MiniCPM-V. Required changes:

1. vllm_ascend/worker/encoder_acl_graph.py:
   - Add `axis_keys: CaptureAxisKeys = ()` to both `_capture_budget_graph(self, token_budget, path='default', axis_keys=())` and `_run_budget_graph(self, mm_kwargs, token_budget, path='default', axis_keys=())`.
   - Key the graph sets by the new BudgetGraphMapKey: store and look up `token_budget if not axis_keys else (token_budget, axis_keys)` (mirror the base class) instead of the bare int `token_budget`; otherwise MiniCPM-V lookups miss and fall back to eager.
   - Make the FIA bookkeeping axis-aware. EncoderGraphParams/set_encoder_graph_params/update_encoder_graph_workspace/update_encoder_graph_params and EncoderForwardContext are keyed by token_budget only. MiniCPM-V sets EncoderCudaGraphConfig.capture_axes=(patch_grid_buckets,), so multiple graphs are captured per budget; per-budget events/handles/workspaces/attn_params lists will accumulate handles from different patch-grid captures, causing `RuntimeError: Encoder graph bookkeeping is inconsistent` or wrong FIA graph_task_update rebinding at replay. Key these by BudgetGraphMapKey (or (token_budget, axis_keys)) and thread axis_keys through set_encoder_forward_context.
   - In `capture()`, derive the budgets/axes (e.g. `self._capture_axes`) when calling set_encoder_graph_params so the bookkeeping covers every (budget, axis) combination.

2. vllm_ascend/ops/mm_encoder_attention.py: `_forward_capture_fia` appends to `params.attn_params[token_budget]`, `params.handles[token_budget]`, and calls update_encoder_graph_workspace(token_budget, ...). Use the axis-aware key derived from get_encoder_forward_context().

3. Model-level compat: MiniCPM-V 2.5/2.6/4.0 are now SupportsEncoderCudaGraph models (new _MiniCPMVEncoderCudaGraphMixin). Its VPM is Idefics2VisionTransformer whose Idefics2VisionAttention uses MMEncoderAttention -> patched to AscendMMEncoderAttention (FIA) on NPU, and Resampler2_5 now calls torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing() (already aliased to torch.npu in model_runner_v1.py) and async_tensor_h2d. Verify MiniCPM-V capture/replay works inside torch.npu.NPUGraph capture on NPU; note the refactored Idefics2VisionEmbeddings.get_position_embedding removed the CPU-sync loop (positive on NPU) but the new vectorized bucketize path must be validated.

4. Update tests/ut/worker/test_encoder_acl_graph.py (it calls mgr._capture_budget_graph(2048) directly and asserts graph_set[2048]) and tests/ut/ops/test_mm_encoder_attention.py for the new signatures, axis keys, and BudgetGraphMapKey indexing. Consider adding a MiniCPM-V encoder-CG e2e test mirroring tests/models/multimodal/generation/test_vit_cudagraph.py new minicpmv_25/26/40 cases.
deep_analysis.risk: High. (1) Hard runtime break: base capture()/execute_budget() unconditionally pass axis_keys, so the unmodified EncoderAclGraphManager raises TypeError for all encoder-CG models on Ascend. (2) MiniCPM-V capture_axes collide with the token_budget-only FIA bookkeeping, risking silent wrong attention rebinding or bookkeeping-inconsistency crashes; if only the signature is fixed but keys are not, MiniCPM-V silently degrades to eager (perf loss). (3) MiniCPM-V's new GPU capture path (flat pixel packing, patch-grid buckets, vectorized resampler, async_tensor_h2d) was only validated on CUDA; NPU graph-capture correctness needs verification. (4) The graph-count multiplication by capture axes increases capture memory/time on NPU and the default encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets through max_model_len can OOM (upstream tests force small budgets [64, 1024]).

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
The commit deletes XD-RoPE entirely: XDRotaryEmbedding (xdrope.py) and the 'xdrope' scaling_type branch in get_rope() are removed; ModelConfig.uses_xdrope_dim/uses_xdrope properties are replaced by ModelConfig.mrope_num_dims (backed by vllm.transformers_utils.config.mrope_num_dims, which treats xdrope_section as a legacy alias of mrope_section); SupportsXDRoPE/supports_xdrope are removed from vllm/model_executor/models/interfaces.py; and GPUModelRunner/SpecDecodeBaseProposer/RopeState/CachedRequestState/NewRequestData all drop their xdrope fields (RopeState.has_delta is also removed). vllm-ascend must update:

1. vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py: NPUModelRunner(v1) relies on the parent GPUModelRunner to set self.uses_xdrope_dim / self.xdrope_positions / self._calc_xdrope_positions. After this commit these no longer exist, so the 'elif self.uses_xdrope_dim > 0:' branches (lines ~1371-1377, 3853-3858) and the async-spec-decode branch (lines ~1529-1533) raise AttributeError for every non-M-RoPE model. Fold XD-RoPE handling into the unified M-RoPE path and use self.mrope_num_dims (set by the new parent init) instead of uses_xdrope_dim; drop self.xdrope_positions/self._calc_xdrope_positions entirely. Note the parent now sizes mrope_positions as [mrope_num_dims, ...], so 4-channel XD-RoPE models (e.g. HunYuan-VL checkpoints with xdrope_section, which now report uses_mrope=True and mrope_num_dims=4) flow through the M-RoPE path.

2. vllm_ascend/_310p/model_runner_310p.py: same treatment for lines ~449-460 (elif self.uses_xdrope_dim > 0 / self._calc_xdrope_positions / self.xdrope_positions).

3. vllm_ascend/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py: AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer.__init__ (lines ~279-289) must no longer branch on self.uses_xdrope_dim/self.draft_uses_xdrope_dim (parent no longer sets them). Allocate self.mrope_positions with self.draft_model_config.mrope_num_dims dims instead of hardcoded 3, and remove the xdrope elif. Remove the XD-RoPE 'target_positions = target_positions[0]' special-case at line ~1658 (the unified parent _set_positions already converts 1D for text drafts).

4. vllm_ascend/_310p/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer_310.py: remove the duplicated 'if self.uses_xdrope_dim > 0 and self.draft_uses_xdrope_dim == 0: target_positions = target_positions[0]' block (line ~103).

5. vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/rope.py: get_310p_rope_state returns Ascend310PRopeState(3, ...) unconditionally; use model_config.mrope_num_dims (max(len(mrope_section), 3)) for consistency with the unified upstream RopeState. The 310P standalone class does not subclass the upstream RopeState, so the has_delta removal does not break it directly.

6. No other change needed for strip_covered_mm_data (its uses_xdrope kwarg was removed from upstream NewRequestData/Scheduler, but vllm-ascend's custom schedulers call NewRequestData.from_request with only positional req/block_ids, so they stay compatible).
deep_analysis.risk: High. This is a removal-based refactor: ModelConfig.uses_xdrope_dim, SpecDecodeBaseProposer.uses_xdrope_dim/draft_uses_xdrope_dim, GPUModelRunner.uses_xdrope_dim/xdrope_positions/_calc_xdrope_positions, SupportsXDRoPE and XDRotaryEmbedding are all deleted upstream. vllm-ascend's v1/310P runners and spec-decode proposers still dereference these in hot execution paths, so without adaptation every model served via the Ascend v1 runner (non-M-RoPE models included, because 'elif self.uses_xdrope_dim > 0:' is evaluated after 'if self.uses_mrope' is False) and every spec-decode path will crash with AttributeError at runtime, not at import/config time. XD-RoPE checkpoints (HunYuan-VL-style, xdrope_section) are now silently re-classified as M-RoPE with 4 channels, so correctness also depends on the runners/proposers switching to the unified M-RoPE path with the derived channel count.
